name: Cyanotype
line: Anna Atkins's Prussian-blue prints as hero and section bands with white Spectral type: on load the whole hero develops from white paper to blue like an exposure, so the seaweed and the headline appear as the unexposed white; the four IARC groups are an exposure strip from deep to pale blue, and the two network drawings are printed white on blue as cyanotypes that develop as they scroll into view.
notes: The three band grounds (#1E417C, #2F6FAA, #3B74B6) are sampled from the plates so each print, whole and uncropped, feathers into its band; white text sits on these solid grounds (5:1 to 10:1), never on the fronds. The exposure-strip tints between Prussian and pale are part of the scale only. The network drawings are recoloured with CSS filters (greyscale, invert, screen blend); game screenshots are toned blue and regain colour on hover. The develop animation is CSS-only and skipped with reduced motion or JavaScript off. Spectral and IBM Plex Sans both cover Cyrillic; Chinese falls back to system fonts.
